text: Travel experiences can be exciting and life-changing. Before going on a trip, planning is very important because you need to book transport, find a place to stay, and decide what to see. When you visit a new country, you discover different cultures, traditions, and ways of life. Trying local food is one of the best parts of travelling, as it helps you understand the place better. Sometimes you face language barriers, but you can use simple words, gestures, or translation apps to communicate. Even small misunderstandings can become funny stories later. In the end, every trip gives you special memories that you will never forget.
